Replaced by a native-safe effect that mirrors the host-computed `visibleProp` (the same `!entry.isIntersecting` boolean, now produced by the host's ScrollView scroll-spy against targetId/topOffset) into the preserved `visible` state via setVisible. handleScrollTop L72-74 (window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})) -> useCallback invoking the optional onScrollToTop host callback. No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, IntersectionObserver, window/document, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web @/components/ui imports remain in the native output — only react, react-native (ActivityIndicator/Pressable/StyleSheet/View), the AppText UI primitive, and theme tokens.
